definitions.gloss: covered in mud; mud-caked; muddy all over
definitions.explanation: The state of being completely covered or smeared with mud. Can also be used figuratively for being mired in difficulty.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{泥|どろ}まみれで{帰|かえ}ってきた。
examples.english: The children came home covered in mud.

examples.japanese: {泥|どろ}まみれの{服|ふく}を{洗濯|せんたく}する。
{雨|あめ}の{中|なか}でサッカーをして、{全身|ぜんしん}{泥|どろ}まみれになった。
examples.english: We played soccer in the rain and got completely covered in mud.

notes: The suffix まみれ means "covered in" or "smeared with" and attaches to nouns: {血|ち}まみれ (covered in blood), {汗|あせ}まみれ (drenched in sweat), {借金|しゃっきん}まみれ (buried in debt). It always implies being covered in something unpleasant or messy — never used for positive things. {泥|どろ}まみれ is one of the most common まみれ compounds.
